QUOTE: `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)  private_##member   /* default: member is renamed */` and `#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)  member             /* when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined */`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the two macro branches (renamed by default, plain member when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined) and says ordinary users get a compile error while the library and opted-in code see real names, which covers the different views per consumer.
